saved_evidence.title: Automated Speed Enforcement: Radar Certificates of Calibration, May 2022
saved_evidence.description: Certificates of calibration for the radar units used in the City's automated speed enforcement programme, each recording the unit tested, the speeds read against simulated speeds, the standard used and the technician who performed the test.
saved_evidence.evidence: Rendered, because the file has nine pages and nine bytes of extractable text. Each page is a ComSonics Repair Services Certificate of Calibration issued to NovoaGlobal, Inc. for a UMRR-11 Type 44 unit, dated May 5, 2022, certifying accuracy within plus or minus 1 mph, with simulated speeds of 25, 35 and 45 mph read as 25.5, 35.5 and 45.4, against a Sensys America simulator traceable to the National Institute of Standards and Technology.

text_excerpts.1:
City of Albuquerque 
Office of Administrative Hearings 
 
Request for Payment Plan 
Automated Speed Enforcement 
 
You will be notified by email and/or mail of the status of your payment plan request. 
 
Date: 
Full Name:  
Mailing Address (#, Street Name, Apt#): 
City, State and Zip Code: 
Phone #: 
 
Email: 
Date of Violation:   
Violation #:  
License Plate #: 
 
 
 
Reason for Request for Payment Plan: 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
I hereby admit to the violation and request a payment plan. If the payment plan request is approved I commit to 
pay the $100 due in minimum $25 installments within 120 days.  
 
Signature Required:  
 
Options for making your payments will be outlined in the Order you will receive directly from NovaGlobal. Please 
note that electronic payments will have an associated service charge fee.  
 
 
Please email this form to automatedspeedappeals@cabq.gov. Or mail your request to the City Clerk’s 
Office, PO Box 1293, Albuquerque, NM 87103. If you have any questions or want to confirm receipt of 
your appeal please call the City Clerk’s Office at 505-924-3650. 
SIGN

Independent Hearing Office 
AUTOMATED SPEED ENFORCEMENT (ASE) 
REQUEST FOR HEARING 
You may Appeal online at: cabq.gov/appeals or submit this form to: 
Office of the City Clerk 
P.O. Box 1293 
Albuquerque, NM 87103 
Today’s Date
Date of Violation
First Name:
Last Name:
MI:

City:
 State:

REASON FOR APPEAL
